protocol.correctness_reference: Fresh FP64 Cholesky of G+zz^T followed by direct double-sided whitening of M=B C^T.
protocol.objective: Pilot an exact dense same-output specialization for the E3 metric-only (w=0) regime without weakening the factor-only boundary.

drag_factor_only.description: Propagate both thin factors without materializing Aw.

drag_materialize.description: Propagate both thin factors and materialize their dense product.

fresh_factor_only.description: Fresh Cholesky and two thin triangular solves without materializing Aw.

fresh_materialize.description: Fresh Cholesky, two thin triangular solves, and dense materialization.

generic_w0_ablation.description: Same new extension and ownership as the specialization, but executes the general v_z recovery, zero-RHS forward solve, and outer-product correction.

metric_only_specialized.description: In-place L and Aw update; omits v_w, v_z, and the identically zero outer-product correction.

protocol.state_preparation: All mutable input cloning and reusable workspace preparation occur before each timed interval.
protocol.stopping_rule: Run every declared rank, width, seed, and path; do not stop or tune from observed outcomes.
protocol.timing_order: Every repetition contains every path once. The declared path order is cyclically rotated by (seed + width_index + repetition) modulo path_count.

source_result_context.source_json_precision: FP32, inferred from the canonical driver default dtype and four-byte storage accounting; this FP64 pilot does not splice its timings into those source rows.
